Two Youths Rescued After Being Swept Away at Telangana Dam

Two youths were rescued after being swept away while attempting to cross a causeway at the Manair Dam in Telangana. The incident occurred when the causeway was submerged. In a separate but related development, the families of two youths declared brain-dead following the incident have donated their organs, which are expected to save nine lives. The rescue operation was successful, and the organ donation has been facilitated.
